notes.title: No One But You Released!
notes.content:
NOBY released!

Great new No One But You has been re-released on Steam due to some conflicts with our old publisher, so we decided to publish independently! We are bringing alot of new changes with this move! 

We will be publishing all new DLC for NOBY including an all new route for Hideaki, more afterstories, and maybe even a new character with enough support from our wonderful community!

So go ahead and grab a copy and get caught up for our new DLC, new games, and possibly a part 2?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289060/No_One_But_You/
